title: Chardet5.2字节检测工作场景
category: 检测状态、解码与归档证据
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：让分块BOM识别与整份输入一致且不丢前缀；区分检测编码身份与Python规范codec可用性；有界检测文件并保留调用者流位置与覆盖事实；逐条检测带标识记录并隔离局部失败；对真实候选执行全文解码及业务验收后再选择；用显式或实际检测codec严格转换完整字节载荷。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Repair UniversalDetector startup to buffer only incomplete possible BOM prefixes until a complete UTF8/16/32 or unusual UCS4 BOM can be distinguished, then use existing detection semantics. Handle UTF16-vs-UTF32 prefix overlap, arbitrary byte/empty chunks, near-prefix mismatches, EOF partial prefixes and reset reuse without losing or duplicating bytes. Ordinary non-BOM input must start probing immediately; preserve original labels, confidence, all probers and frozen upstream tests.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_chardet_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-chardet-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Implement chardet.files.detect_file(source, *, preserve_position=True, chunk_size=65536, max_bytes=None) on the delivered split-BOM detector. Support text/PathLike paths and caller-owned binary streams, short reads and exact nonnegative byte budgets without lookahead. Restore seekable caller positions on success/failure, never close caller streams, close owned files, and report actual read_bytes/eof/budget_exhausted without claiming an inspected prefix validates the whole file. Zero budget performs no reads; nonseekable preserving mode and text reads fail explicitly.
